question: A can lay a railway track between two given stations in 8 days and B can do the same job in 24 days. With the help of C, they can do the job in 3 days. C alone can do the job in:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = **LCM(8, 24, 3) = 24 units**.

Efficiency of **A = 3**, **B = 1**, and **(A + B + C) = 8**.

Efficiency of **C = 8 − (3 + 1) = 4**.

Time taken by **C = 24 ÷ 4 = 6 days**.

**∴ The correct answer is 6 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Time taken by **A = 8 days**, **B = 24 days**, and **(A + B + C) = 3 days**.

⇒ Efficiency of **C** = Efficiency of **(A + B + C)** − Efficiency of **A** − Efficiency of **B**

⇒ Efficiency of **C** = 8 − 3 − 1 = 4 units/day

⇒ Time taken by **C** = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of **C**

⇒ Time taken by **C** = 24 ÷ 4 = 6 days

**∴ The correct answer is 6 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Work Formula

**Total Work** is always considered as the **LCM** of the individual number of days to simplify efficiency calculations.

Efficiency Relationship

**Efficiency** is inversely proportional to **Time**. If time increases, efficiency decreases for the same amount of work (E = W ÷ T).

Combined Work

If individuals work together, their **efficiencies** are added to find the combined rate of work per day.</p
